notes: Tier A rules from plan/rdl-rule-set.md (RDL Static Analysis epic). Severity here uses the envelope's own error/warning/info vocabulary, mapped from the rule set's High/Medium/Low: High -> error, Medium/Low -> warning. 'aliases' on LAY-03 records that it and SUB-01 share one check function and one finding, per the epic's requirement that a subreport nested in a tablix produce a single finding carrying both IDs -- SUB-01 stays its own catalog entry (disable/severity apply to it independently) but is not dispatched a second time.

rules.name: Report uses a current RDL schema
rules.description: Default xmlns on <Report> older than .../reporting/2016/01/reportdefinition. Power BI accepts SSRS 2016+; upgrade by opening and saving in Report Builder.
rules.source: MS Learn: Find schema version; What are paginated reports

rules.name: Use shared data sources
rules.description: DataSource has DataSourceReference, not an embedded ConnectionProperties/ConnectString. Also flags credentials embedded in the connect string.

rules.name: No unused datasets
rules.description: Every DataSet/@Name should appear in some DataSetName, DataSetReference/DataSetName, or expression -- an unused dataset still runs every time the report does.
rules.source: MS Learn: Data retrieval guidance; MSSQLTips #3659, rule 3

rules.name: No SELECT *
rules.description: Query/CommandText should list only the columns the report uses -- a bare EVALUATE 'Table' is the DAX equivalent for a PBIDATASET source.
rules.source: MSSQLTips #3659, rule 4; MS Learn: Data retrieval guidance

rules.name: Prefer stored procedures for relational sources
rules.description: Query/CommandType should be StoredProcedure rather than inline text for a relational (SQL) data source.
rules.source: MS Learn: Data retrieval guidance; DMC blog, 2023

rules.name: Filter in the query, not the report
rules.description: DataSet/Filters or Tablix/Filters present -- prefer a WHERE clause or query parameter; a report filter fetches everything first.
rules.source: MS Learn: Performance and scalability; MSSQLTips #3659, rule 6

rules.name: No report-level calculated fields
rules.description: A Field with a Value child (an expression) instead of DataField -- move the expression into the query.
rules.source: MS Learn: Data retrieval guidance; MSSQLTips #3659, rule 7

rules.name: Aggregate in the query
rules.description: Sum(, Count(, Avg( in a textbox Value over a detail-level dataset with many rows -- use GROUP BY in CommandText instead.
rules.source: MS Learn: Performance and scalability; MSSQLTips #4006

rules.name: Sort in the query
rules.description: SortExpressions on a tablix group that duplicate an order that could be an ORDER BY.

rules.name: Convert types in the query
rules.description: CDate(, CInt(, CDec(, CStr( repeated on the same field across expressions -- cast once in SQL.

rules.name: Join in the query, not with Lookup
rules.description: Lookup(, LookupSet(, MultiLookup( in expressions -- replace with a SQL join, or a Power BI semantic model when sources differ.
rules.source: MSSQLTips #4006; MS Learn: Data retrieval guidance

rules.name: Move complex SQL into views or procs
rules.description: Long CommandText (over max_lines) for a SQL provider is easier to maintain outside the RDL.

rules.name: Every parameter has a sensible default
rules.description: Each ReportParameter should have a DefaultValue so the report runs on open.

rules.name: Keep the parameter count low
rules.description: Separate Year/Month/Day parameters should usually be one DateTime picker.

rules.name: No MultiValue + Nullable combination
rules.description: MultiValue = true together with Nullable = true isn't supported. MultiValue + AllowBlank is fine.
rules.source: MS Learn: Power BI Report Builder

rules.name: Show selected parameter values on the report
rules.description: Each parameter name should appear as Parameters!Name.Value or .Label inside a Textbox, so exported copies stay self-explanatory.

rules.name: Body fits the page
rules.description: ReportSection/Width + Page/LeftMargin + Page/RightMargin should be <= Page/PageWidth, or PDF/print gets blank overflow pages.

rules.name: Avoid TotalPages
rules.description: Globals!TotalPages in an expression slows PDF and image rendering.

rules.name: Avoid subreports inside data regions
rules.description: A Subreport nested in a Tablix runs once per row. Same detection as SUB-01; fires as one finding carrying both IDs.

rules.name: Use interactive sort only when needed
rules.description: UserSort elements on textboxes, used only when interactive sort is actually wanted.

rules.name: Large reports have page breaks
rules.description: A tablix over a large dataset should have a Group/PageBreak/BreakLocation, or nothing shows until the whole report renders.

rules.name: Avoid embedded images
rules.description: EmbeddedImages/EmbeddedImage present, or Image/Source = Embedded -- prefer External or Database.

rules.name: Prefer nested data regions or drillthrough over a subreport in a tablix
rules.description: A Subreport inside a Tablix runs once per row, parameters included. Detected by the same check as LAY-03 -- see that entry's finding.
rules.source: MS Learn: Add a subreport and parameters; MS Learn: Subreports (SSRS)

rules.name: Stay under 50 subreports per main report
rules.description: 50 or more Subreport elements in the main RDL fail to render in the service.

rules.name: Every object has alt text
rules.description: Each Image, Chart, Tablix, GaugePanel and Map should have a non-empty ToolTip -- screen readers read it in the service and in Accessible PDF.

rules.name: Chart alt text describes the insight
rules.description: Chart/ToolTip should state what the chart shows, not a default name like 'Chart1'.

rules.name: Tables have a caption or summary
rules.description: Tablix/ToolTip should summarise what the table conveys.

rules.name: HTML links carry alt text
rules.description: A TextRun with MarkupType = HTML that renders a hyperlink should also have a ToolTip.
